subject: Mobile Development
title: AI-Powered Photography
description: A quick, practical guide to AI-Powered Photography.

hook.text: Your phone takes 12 photos when you press the shutter once, then AI merges them into one perfect shot.

buildup.text: Computational photography uses AI to enhance lighting, remove noise, and sharpen details.

discovery.text: Google's Magic Eraser removes unwanted objects. Apple's Photonic Engine enhances low-light shots.

twist.text: AI photos look better than reality. Critics argue phone cameras no longer capture truth.

climax.text: AI has made phone cameras rival professional equipment — by processing, not just capturing light.

punchline.text: The best camera is the AI behind the lens.

quiz.question: How does computational photography improve phone cameras?
options: AI merges multiple shots and enhances them
